comment: Sevii quest chain, beat 4: the Sapphire theft, Dotted Hole Sapphire Room (pokefirered SixIsland_DottedHole_SapphireRoom_EventScript_Sapphire). The player reaches the Sapphire; the scientist (Gideon) drops in, gloats, takes the Sapphire off its pedestal - in the source the player NEVER holds the item here (removeobject on the pedestal object), so this script grants nothing - and leaves after revealing the Rocket Warehouse password (his second line). His two dialogue lines are exact restored-bank labels (bridge ref SixIsland_DottedHole_SapphireRoom_EventScript_Sapphire). The obtain-fanfare line (Text_FoundSapphire) is not a say step. Sets sevii_sapphire_stolen (authored; the source tracks this through the warehouse scene var and FLAG_LEARNED_YES_NAH_CHANSEY).
